BiblicalUsage: Merab is Saul's firstborn daughter, promised to David and then given to another. 1 Samuel 14:49 names her first among Saul's daughters, and 1 Samuel 18:17 has Saul offer her to David if he will fight the LORD's battles. 1 Samuel 18:19 tells the end of the promise: when the time came, Merab was given to Adriel the Meholathite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Merab is a warning about promises made as bait: Saul offered his daughter to get David killed, and the promise was never his to keep.
